videos.title: The Yellow Mountain
videos.description: Two gold prospectors persuade the owner of a hitherto worthless mine to reconsider his decision to cease excavation. While on a joint dig with the owner and his daughter, one of the prospectors unexpectedly strikes gold, but the precious discovery creates conflict between the duo and prompts unwanted attention from a rival intent on acquiring the gold for himself, at any cost.

videos.title: Deck the Halls
videos.description: Steve Finch has the best Christmas in town, until brash salesman Buddy Hall moves in next door and puts in so many lights that his house can be seen from space. Cue a battle to decide who achieves seasonal supremacy.

videos.title: A Christmas Carol
videos.description: Ebenezer Scrooge, a spiteful and miserly man, encounters three spirits on Christmas Eve who show him the folly of his ways.

videos.title: Miracle on 34th Street
videos.description: Kringle gets a job at Cole's department store on 34th Street thanks to toy department executive Dorey Walker, who, like her daughter Susan, doesn't believe in Santa Claus. However, such is Kringle's success that a rival store, losing money, decides to have him declared insane for his insistence on his identity. The case comes to trial, with Dorey's would-be suitor out to prove that he really is Santa Claus.

videos.title: Multiplicity
videos.description: A man who never has enough time for the things he wants to do is offered the chance to change all that through the power of cloning.

videos.title: The Equalizer 3
videos.description: Finding himself at home in Southern Italy, former operative Robert McCall soon discovers his new friends are under the control of local crime bosses. As events turn deadly, McCall becomes their protector by taking on the mafia.

videos.title: American Gangster
videos.description: Harlem drug dealer Frank Lucas rises to power in corrupt 1970s New York, equalling and surpassing the notorious Mafia families with the reach of his empire. On the other side of the law, honest cop Richie Roberts dedicates himself to taking down `the most dangerous man walking the streets'. Lucas acts with impunity, smuggling heroin into the US in the coffins of American soldiers killed in Vietnam.

videos.title: Hush
videos.description: On a night-time motorway journey, young couple Zakes and Beth catch a horrifying glimpse of a young woman imprisoned in the back of a truck. When the two stop at a service station, Beth goes missing and a terrified Zakes races to track her down, fearing she has become the driver's next victim.

videos.title: Buchanan Rides Alone
videos.description: A lone rider arrives in a small town and meets a young boy who, while awaiting trial for the murder of the local bully, fears he may be killed by his victim's family. As he becomes involved in the morass of shifting partnerships that dominate the community, the rider vows to fight against the three corrupt brothers who are intent on taking the law into their own violent hands.

videos.title: Arthur Christmas
videos.description: Everyone knows that, each Christmas, Santa Claus delivers presents to every last child on Earth. What everyone doesn't know is that Santa accomplishes the feat with a very high-tech operation beneath the North Pole. But when the unthinkable happens, and Santa misses one child out of hundreds of millions, someone has to save the day. It's up to Arthur (James McAvoy), Santa's youngest son, to deliver a present to the forgotten tyke before Christmas morning dawns.

videos.title: How the Grinch Stole Christmas
videos.description: Shunned by the relentlessly happy citizens of Whoville, the Grinch retreats to his gloomy lair on Mt Crumpit. Come December, the only one smiling is the Grinch, who's stolen everyone's presents. However, a little girl sees some good in the furry grouch, so there may be a merry Christmas after all.

videos.title: Home Alone
videos.description: Left behind when his family goes away for Christmas holiday, Kevin McCallister enjoys unprecedented freedom of the house and the possessions of his siblings. Using an array of homemade weaponry, he manages to fend off a pair of dim-witted burglars.

videos.title: Home Alone 2: Lost in New York
videos.description: A boy is once again accidentally separated from his parents after an airport mix-up sees him lost and alone in New York. Coincidentally, two familiar villains are also in town plotting their finest crime to date.

videos.title: Angel Has Fallen
videos.description: Wrongfully accused of trying to kill the president, a framed Secret Service agent must evade the FBI and his own agency to uncover the truth and save the country from imminent danger.

videos.title: Copshop
videos.description: On the run from a lethal assassin, a wily con artist devises a scheme to hide out inside a small-town police station. However, when the hitman turns up at the precinct, an unsuspecting rookie cop finds herself caught in the crosshairs.

videos.title: Holy Cow
videos.description: After the death of his father, an 18-year-old must look after his younger sister and their failing family farm. He assumes even more responsibility when he enters a competition for the best Comté cheese made in the western part of the French Alps.
